rows.ARS:
Medium pink Hybrid Tea.
Registration name: BALrihus
rows.Origin:
Discovered by Don and Paula Ballin (United States, 2003).
Introduced in United States by Edmunds' Roses in 2003.
rows.Bloom: Pink. Mild fragrance. 17 to 25 petals. Double (17-25 petals), borne mostly solitary, spiral centers bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Tall, compact. Medium, semi-glossy, medium green foliage.

Height: 5' to 7' (150 to 215cm).
rows.Growing: USDA zone 6b through 9b (default). Can be used for cut flower or garden. Remove spent blooms to encourage re-bloom. Spring Pruning: Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood and cut back canes that cross. In warmer climates, cut back the remaining canes by about one-third. In colder areas, you'll probably find you'll have to prune a little more than that.
